02a4df5f9777d66c5d1060a942e10e18684cf3f9.summary: Zscaler ThreatLabz analysed exploitation of CVE-2026-88771, a critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances, disclosed on September 27, 2026. Attackers staged a payload in access logs and forged an authentication-log entry, which a privileged maintenance script later executed. Observed follow-on activity included web shell deployment and a FreeBSD implant. The report notes an infrastructure overlap with StyleSmuggler (CVE-2026-75650), but says this does not establish threat actor attribution. It also lists indicators of compromise and…

02e61990f3e053afd9e6aaa3b1a6fd466e46fbd3.summary: Breakglass Intelligence reports on a Kimsuky command-and-control server with directory listing enabled, serving a three-stage kill chain that starts from a CHM help file disguised as API documentation. The stages cover system reconnaissance with scheduled-task persistence, a PowerShell bridge, and a keylogger with clipboard monitoring and timed exfiltration. The report maps about 79 domains across five IPs on Korean and US VPS providers and free dynamic DNS services, including Naver and tax-themed phishing lures aimed at South Korean users.
